facts.anchor: I made my first sale!” I bragged to Georgia when she called that evening. “A clit stimulator.”
facts.fact: 她承认自己借 Zak 的 toys 缓解压力——「I haven't had that in a long time.」

facts.anchor: Ali had come back after her shift. By then, she’d done some research, and I had too. We compared notes and, after a little more browsing, she settled on a model that attached to her finger.
facts.fact: 她向 Georgia 报喜：卖出第一单——阴蒂刺激器（Ali 的指戴式、不到三十美元）。

facts.anchor: “Doesn’t it feel great to make the world a better place, one orgasm at a time?” Georgia teased.
facts.fact: Georgia 透露手术可采用创伤更小的新术式，但她的偏执大脑认定不该再买青香蕉。

facts.anchor: “Can I paint that on the wall? Live, Love, Orgasm? Oh, hey—Mom came by and has some great ideas for the window. I’ll send you a photo tomorrow, and you can let us know if we’re on the right
facts.fact: Georgia 交权：照片可以发、我有力气才回，但别指望太多——我得先把店放下。

facts.anchor: “George? Am I overstepping?” Shit. “You’re right about the two of us being way too keen when we’ve got a project. I won’t do anything you don’t like.”
facts.fact: 袋里留了进货推荐清单，Georgia 让她亲自试用并判断哪些值得上架。
